title: Clarify live route timeline label
summary: Clarified the live Run Progress route step so it names the backend route when reported and says the route decision is pending when no route evidence exists.
reason: The previous route timeline label could show 'Route selected' while raw backend route evidence still read as none/not reported, which made the operator-facing state ambiguous.
behavior_before: Run Progress could render a current step labeled 'Route selected' without naming a route or having backend route evidence.
behavior_after: Run Progress renders 'Route selected: <route>' only when a meaningful route is reported; otherwise it renders 'Route decision pending' with a no-route detail message.
